what: eval_test_runner.sh defaults EVAL_CAPTURE_L1=1, which disables+clears the program cache per graded test; any LOOSE_CASE with trace_replay then hits TT_FATAL Cannot load new binaries during trace capture for every implementation, and helpers.run_scenario does not end_trace_capture in a finally, so all later tests fail (Writes not supported during trace capture) and the module device reopen segfaults (exit 139, no JUnit, reported as HANGS=1)
suggest: keep the program cache on (or skip L1 capture) for trace_replay cases, and wrap begin/end_trace_capture in try/finally in the golden helper template

what: the documented verify_supported command fails outside the pytest wrappers with ImportError undefined symbol MPIX_Comm_shrink; it needs the LD_PRELOAD stub from .tt_chip_scope

what: on this board the profiler CHIP_FREQ moved 800/1112/1350 MHz between sessions, so the same build measured 2535-3151 us on case 703; device-ns from separate runs (incl. the implementer recorded baseline) are not comparable, and nothing tells perf agents to A/B within one session or log the clock
suggest: state in perf_rules / perf-measure: compare variants interleaved inside one pytest session and record CHIP_FREQ (or report cycles) with every number

what: the full verify_supported JSON for a 1349-cell suite is 693 KB and the repo pre-commit check-large-files hook rejects >500 KB, blocking the commit
suggest: have verify_supported emit compact output (node ids only for supported_pass) or tell agents to keep the artifact out of the repo

what: every perf refinement must target the flagged LOOSE_CASE, so a measured 3.2x deficit vs stock on a 77-case non-flagged production class (587 single-row) has no legal queue slot even though the lead goal is faster than the incumbent in every production case
suggest: allow a perf slot for a measured regression vs the incumbent on a non-flagged production class, or require the golden author to flag such classes
